title: [Layers, Apps] Remove CLEAN27 obsolete code
summary: Obsolete code guarded by CLEAN27 preprocessor tags is removed from W1 and regional/country apps, including 140 deleted AL files for entirely obsolete objects and unwrapped replacement code throughout the application layers.
key_points: 766 AL files modified across W1, regional, and country-specific implementations to remove CLEAN27 conditional branches
140 entire AL files deleted where objects were entirely obsolete and no replacement code remained
Dependent code cleaned up including GB Sales Line and Sales Document Test reports that called removed VAT reverse-charge helpers
Seven unchanged copies recorded in Miapp exclusion snapshot where no CLEAN27 gates applied to country-specific implementations
Validation completed using preprocessor configuration audit across 1,328 configurations
quote: Remove obsolete code guarded by `CLEAN27` throughout `src/Layers` and `src/Apps`, selecting the branches used when `CLEAN27` is defined.
